reviews.title: 13 degrees over the air cooler
reviews.comment: This PL360 dropped my idle temp on my i7-11700 by 13 degrees over the air cooler. Under a stress test the CPU would throttle with the air cooler it got so hot. I was thinking, I am hoping the PL360 would keep it below 70 degrees. To my surprise it NEVER hit 50 degrees. For thirty minutes I stressed this CPU @ 100% and it never hit 50! I heard reviews stating this PL360 was loud. I my not hear as good as I once did but it is quiet as a mouse. So far, I am very happy with the PL360.

reviews.title: Cools a Ryzen 9 5900x
reviews.comment: Been a few months of using it with my Ryzen 9 5900x and it does a pretty darn cool job. I dont think I get above 75 celsius very often and thats always when I am pushing the system pretty hard. It idles around 50c and esports titles usually run around 65c. Its very bright and RGB is not really my thing but I dont see it in my case so it doesnt bother me. It fits like it should.
reviews.author: Pixel dork

reviews.title: Cools very well
reviews.comment: It really keeps my CPU cool. It was very easy to install in my box. I have a 11900K processor and I do a lot of gaming. So heat can be a real problem and it can destroy your processor, But this cooler seems to be up to the job and i will recommend it.
reviews.author: Ginabean

reviews.title: Some parts missing
reviews.comment: I did not receive thermal paste or the 3-to-1 fan cable splitter with mine — they were easy and cheap enough to replace, but that’s still a disappointment. The plastic cover for the underside of the heat sink was also taken off already when I opened the box, so I’m wondering if I received a repurposed return that they didn’t quite check over enough. But, if you have all the correct parts, this system runs great! Keeps my Intel 12th gen i9 CPU cool, runs super quiet for the most part, and the RGB lights are beautiful.
reviews.author: James
